newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile protesters demand better prison conditions.
newsitem.headline: Chile protesters demand better prison conditions.

text.p: Four relatives of jailed Chilean leftist guerrillas entered the Australian embassy and refused to leave on Thursday to call attention to their demands for better prison conditions in Chile for the inmates.

In front of television cameras, the three women and one man entered the embassy's immigration section and erected signs demanding better conditions for their relatives, whom they called political prisoners, at two prisons in Santiago, an embassy official said.
The four shouted their demands to reporters outside the embassy, which was later closed, said the official.
The action was completely peaceful and the four were not armed, and nor did they attempt to damage the embassy in any way, said the official, who asked not to be identified.
"We've told the Chilean authorities we don't think this requires any action. We've asked them to reduce the normal police presence outside to one officer, and they have done that," he said.
"These people have come to make a point. We're just going to let them stew in their juices for a while," he added.
